_comment: Hand-curated additions and fixes, merged into every run. Use for permanent venues (Places tab), seasonal farm activities, and geocode/classification corrections. date_kind 'permanent' = a standing attraction; give it lat/lng so distance works. Any classification field set here bypasses the Claude step.

activities.description_nl: Doe-centrum voor wetenschap en techniek met honderden hands-on opstellingen voor kinderen. Losse activiteiten en shows in vakanties.
activities.blurb_en: Hands-on science and technology discovery centre with hundreds of interactive exhibits for kids.

activities.description_nl: Dierenpark met grote speeltuinen, boottochtjes en seizoensevenementen (Halloween, winter).
activities.blurb_en: Animal park with large playgrounds, boat rides and seasonal events.

activities.description_nl: Stedelijk kunstmuseum in het centrum van Leuven met een gezinsaanbod en ateliers tijdens vakanties.
activities.blurb_en: City art museum in central Leuven with a family offer and school-holiday workshops.
